name: Rating
summary: A score fitted to pairwise votes between models, as with Elo or Bradley-Terry; it compares models only inside one snapshot of one arena, never across arenas or dates.

name: Accuracy
summary: The share of the items of a test that a system answers correctly, from 0 to 1; on a multiple-choice test, random guessing sets its floor.

name: Macro-averaged accuracy
summary: The mean of the accuracies on the subsets of a test, such as the subjects of MMLU, each counted equally whatever its size; it differs from accuracy over all items.
